decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through contacts are a close extension of the firm's core glass-silicon competence, so keeping this option open costs little while demand for advanced packaging keeps growing.
Carrier wafers for smaller diameters fit the firm's strategic push into reusable carriers and thin-wafer handling, and carrying the product costs almost nothing.
Cu-interposer glass wafers address the still uncertain but promising glass interposer market, so the option's value has not yet resolved and is worth holding.
The off-the-shelf Wafer Universe brand uses existing standard products with low upkeep, though a narrow-range firm could fold the brand back into its main offer.

Glass-based circuit boards are distant from the core and appeared only once, but uncertainty remains high and glass substrates are gaining interest, so the cheap option is kept for now despite elevated drop risk.
